prior_round.test_access_notice: This new round will access the two real test datasets. The earlier untouched-test development registration cannot subsequently be represented as still blind to these tests.

training_inputs: all train/good images, no abnormal training images, no gradient optimization

model.image_geometry: RGB full-frame resize 224x224, ImageNet normalization; no center crop
model.covariance: unbiased sample covariance at each spatial location, plus 0.01 I
model.statistical_estimation: streaming float64 sufficient statistics; persist float64 statistics
model.geometry_note: PaDiM-style reproduction with explicit resize geometry; do not assert exact reproduction of all author preprocessing or published scores.

candidate_hypothesis: Fixed trace-scaled covariance shrinkage may stabilize local Gaussian scores. The result may improve or regress; report every category and all four variants.
hyperparameter_policy: All variant parameters fixed before the first real test inference; no result-driven parameter selection, category dropping or sample substitution in this round.

metrics.raw_map: distance 56 -> bilinear 224 -> Gaussian native sigma -> bilinear 256; no per-image score normalization
metrics.mask: nearest-neighbor 256x256, values greater than zero are abnormal
metrics.image_auroc: maximum of the saved float32 raw map
metrics.pixel_auroc: exact rank-based AUROC with tied-score averaging
metrics.aupro_0_30: exact equal-region AUPRO, 8-connectivity, all background pixels, tie grouping and linear interpolation at FPR 0.30

visualization_selection: first normal and first anomalous sample by frozen lexical sample_id for every category; same scale for all variants
